anomalies.observed: J2 pin 4 (the fourth pin of the 1x04 FAN connector) is connected to the GND net.
anomalies.expected: On a standard 4-pin fan header, pin 4 is the PWM control input and should be left unconnected (or driven by a PWM signal) when the fan is controlled by switching power; tying it to GND grounds the fan's PWM input.
anomalies.impact: A 4-pin fan plugged into J2 will have its PWM input grounded, which may cause it to run at minimum speed or stop instead of running at full speed when power is applied.

anomalies.observed: C2 is 100nF on the +5V output of the LM1117-5.0 regulator.
anomalies.expected: The LM1117 datasheet requires a minimum output capacitance of 10uF (tantalum or aluminum) for stability; 100nF is far too small.
anomalies.impact: The 5V regulator may oscillate or be unstable, causing unreliable operation of the MCUs and logic.
